Douglas McWilliams, alleged solicitor of sex workers and sometimes economist has a bright and bold theory that hipsters - in his words "The Flat White Economy" - are ostensibly "saving" city areas with their quirky tastes and penchant for paying exorbitant rents.

You just can't make this bullshit up, can you -- its too mental. Have a read here: http://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2015/mar/08/can-hipsters-save-the-world

While the guardian asks the question "Can hipsters save the world", I'd like to point to beardo-overrun areas like Williamsburg and Shoreditch in the UK as examples of "FUCK NO". The very term that McWilliams uses "Flat White" evokes a mental image of a huge bleached wheel of stone, flattening residents and crushing small mom-and-pop stores.

Hipsters are a symptom of a larger problem, much like maggots bursting from a cadaver, the festering dead flesh feeding their millisecond attention spans. Its a brand of super-white-escapism, not willing to face up to the fact that yes, indeed, we may be reaching the pinnacle of any societal achievement, so now young people engage in a bawdy round of navel-gazing, hoping all the troubles will go away.

We need adults, not children, but unfortunately that lesson won't be learned until the very last dollar is emptied from their parents trust fund, and the bearded masses have to finally fend for themselves.

Reality is a bitch, and their vacant faces need a well-deserved double backhand.

Not that I'm any kind of expert however, my girlfriend who told me about him has seen (/played, given that he has written visual novels as well as anime scripts) a lot more of his stuff than I have. I've only watched Madoka and Blassreiter fully.

He also did Kamen Rider Gaim, but I haven't seen that.
